Rationale: ice cream and the existing ice-cream identity are the same learner unit with identical sense 冰淇淋; spacing/hyphenation does not justify a second Stable NoteID.
pencil-box and the existing pencil box identity are orthographic variants of the same learner unit 铅笔盒.
school bag and schoolbag denote the same learner unit 书包; spacing does not create a distinct vocabulary identity.
stomach ache and stomachache are orthographic variants with identical learner sense 胃痛；肚子痛.

theater is the American spelling counterpart of theatre. The third-party gloss 剧院；电影院 is a wording/breadth variation of the same elementary place concept represented by KV000393=剧院, not an independent homograph identity.
